pins.title: A Long Weekend on Virginia's Northern Neck: 4-Day Itinerary
pins.description: A 4-day itinerary for Virginia's Northern Neck: Thursday check-in and the first sunset, a crab pot pulled at dawn, kayaks on a slow tidal creek, low boil on the screened porch, home Sunday.
pins.altText: The dock at Captain's Cottage on a still morning, creek flat and grey-blue before sunrise.

pins.title: Waterfront Long Weekend: 2 Hours 45 Minutes from DC
pins.description: A waterfront long weekend 2 hours 45 minutes from Washington DC. Cedar sauna and a cold dip off the dock after dark, crabbing at dawn, Reedville and Irvington a short drive away.
pins.altText: The cedar barrel sauna beside the water at dusk on Virginia's Northern Neck.

pins.title: Crab Pull, Kayaks, Sauna: A Chesapeake Weekend Itinerary
pins.description: Crab pull at dawn, kayaks on a slow tidal creek, a cedar sauna after dark. The full weekend on Virginia's Northern Neck, where the Potomac meets the Chesapeake Bay.
pins.altText: Kayaks and a paddleboard at the dock on a Northern Neck tidal creek.
